title: Zahoor Hoga Zaroor Hoga
body:
Hai sab hi qaael ke ek din abse toor hoga
zahoor hoga zaroor hoga
jaha'n pa zahir imam honge zahoor hoga zaroor hoga
Imam maujud har jagah hai na dekh paye jo be baseerat
to isme imaan o agahi ka kusoor hoga, zaroor hoga
Imam niptenge khud hi use jo unki ghaibat pa tanazan hai
koi dino ki hai baat jabse zahoor hoga zaroor hoga
Kaseem e naar o jina ali bu-turaab se jisko dushmani hai
fishar e qabr uska hai muqaddar zaroor hoga zaroor hoga
Ali ko dil se pukaar dekho pukarte hai malang jaise
hai mera daawa tumhe bhi hasil suroor hoga zaroor hoga
Ziyarat o zikr e murtaza mein na ho ziyarat jo ambiya ki
to aise zahn o damaagh o dil mein futoor hoga zaroor hoga
Hai murtaza baab e ilm o hikmat jo isse bach kar chalega uske
jehalato ka himakato ka sudoor hoga zaroor hoga
Adu e ghaire kaseer yani jo dushman e aale mustafa hai
to aisa hi banda hauz e kausar se door hoga zaroor hoga
Wila e aale nabi ke sadqe hamari duniya bhi motabar hai
ba roz e mehshar husool e qurb e huzoor hoga zaroor hoga
Naye naye naghma haay midhat suna raha hai jo sibt e jafar
to shaeri aur adaegi par kuboor hoga zaroor hoga
